name: VM Manager
description: O CCS Console numa tela própria: as VMs do Proxmox, o Ceph, os buckets, as rotas do OPNsense, os usuários e a auditoria, com o login "Entrar com Marrow" em um clique. O Claude também usa as VMs e os buckets como ferramentas (listar, criar, ligar, desligar, destruir com confirmação), com o seu login.
author: Arthur Fonseca

tools.name: vm_manager_list
tools.description: List the VMs of the CCS Proxmox cluster (vmid, name, type, status, node, size, IP, tags). Templates are left out. Use it to find a VM before vm_manager_get/vm_manager_start/vm_manager_stop/vm_manager_destroy.

tools.name: vm_manager_get
tools.description: Details of one VM by vmid or exact name: status, size, IP, disks, OS type and guest agent.

vm.description: VM id (number) or exact VM name.

tools.name: vm_manager_catalog
tools.description: What a new VM can use: nodes, storages, templates, the environment defaults (cores, memory MiB, disk GiB) and the SSH user of new VMs. Read it before vm_manager_create to pick a sensible size.

tools.name: vm_manager_create
tools.description: Create a VM (clone + cloud-init + NetBox) and wait until it is ready with an IP, for up to ~100 s. Your local SSH public key is added, and the result has `ssh` (user@ip) ready to use. If it is still creating, the result says "em andamento": call vm_manager_wait with the same name. Never call vm_manager_create again for the same name.

name.description: VM hostname: lowercase letters, digits and hyphen (1-63 chars).

cores.description: vCPU cores (1-64). Omit for the default.

memoryMiB.description: Memory in MiB (512-524288). Omit for the default.

diskGiB.description: Root disk in GiB (4-2048). Omit for the default.

template.description: Template to clone (from vm_manager_catalog). Omit for the default.

node.description: Target node (from vm_manager_catalog). Omit for the default.

storage.description: Disk storage (from vm_manager_catalog). Omit for the default.

ipCidr.description: IPv4 with CIDR, e.g. 192.168.100.80/24. Omit to get the next free IP.

backup.description: Include in the daily backup. Default true.

ha.description: Include in the cluster HA. Default true.

startAfterCreate.description: Start the VM after creating. Default true.

tools.name: vm_manager_wait
tools.description: Keep waiting (up to ~100 s per call) for a VM creation that vm_manager_create left "em andamento". Never creates anything.

vm.description: VM id (number) or exact VM name.
VM id (number) or exact VM name.

tools.name: vm_manager_destroy
tools.description: Destroy a VM and remove it from NetBox. The user is always asked to confirm in Maestria; if they cancel or do not answer in time, nothing is destroyed. Only VMs, not containers or templates.

vm.description: VM id (number) or exact VM name.

tools.name: vm_manager_bucket_list
tools.description: List the S3 buckets (name, owner, objects, used bytes, quota) and the owners a new bucket can have.

tools.name: vm_manager_bucket_create
tools.description: Create an S3 bucket for an existing owner, or for a new owner with newOwner=true. Returns no secret: use vm_manager_bucket_credentials to get the keys into a file.

owner.description: Owner uid (from vm_manager_bucket_list), or the new owner uid.

newOwner.description: Create the owner too. Default false.

tools.name: vm_manager_bucket_credentials
tools.description: Write the S3 credentials of a bucket owner to a local .env file (mode 0600) and return only its path, the access key and the endpoint. The secret key is only in the file: copy the file to the server with scp and use it by path. Never print its contents (no cat, echo or grep of the secret).
